## ★★★ NORTH STAR (READ FIRST) — ONE unified hub registry. Full doc: `_docs/architecture/unified-hub-registry.md`
The day's fragmentation (FEH 3 names, AI-house phantom cards, dup hubs, orphans) is ONE disease: we have MANY separate
hub registries (HubRegistry.js + each house's hardcoded config.paths + LearningPaths.js + ContentCatalog.js + 10 tenant
dashboards + handler-dashboard.js PATH_HOUSE_MAP + per-course *Data.js like feh-map/ForensicsData/SignalData/ProjectsData)
— each names hubs independently, so they drift. CURE (Frank's vision): ONE database of hubs (HubRegistry is the natural
home), every hub a single record with ORGANIZATION metadata (house [derive from hubHref], category [already exists:
cert-prep|course|platform-hub|tool — this IS the Learning-Paths-vs-House-Content filter], tags/labels/filters). Every
view = a FILTERED PROJECTION, not a copy: house tab = house=X & type=content; Learning Paths = house=X & cert-linked;
Explore All = everything (catalog, same every house); dashboards/instructor = other filters. No hub ever LISTED twice —
FILTERED into place. Standard house/dashboard skeleton (verified HouseRenderer.js) = 5 tabs: 1 Learning Paths (certs),
2 House Content (house-domain), 3 Explore All (catalog), 4 Profile, 5 Instructor. Tabs 1-3 hold hubs = 3 filters on 1 set.
OPEN FORKS (discussed, NOT decided): (a) which registry becomes THE db (HubRegistry closest, needs org metadata added);
(b) one migration vs house-by-house (prove on AI house first); (c) first step = design schema together OR pull into
HubRegistry + point one consumer as proof. AI HOUSE is the wedge: 7 real live hubs (cortex/ai-900/agents/automation/
advanced/azure-openai/cli-tools) but page lists 3 PHANTOM cards (ai-foundations/ai-builder/ai-security matching nothing).
DO NOT patch the AI house's 3 cards in isolation — it's the first candidate for the real unified-registry fix.
Frank halted "shotgun" ~this point: DISCUSS design before building. This was a DESIGN discussion, no code written for it yet.
